slides.stem: A sector of a circle has an arc length of $3\pi$ centimeters and a radius of $9$ centimeters. What is the area, in square centimeters, of the sector?

slides.intro: Recover the angle from the arc first.

slides.title: Arc to angle to area
slides.body:
Arc length $s = r\theta$ unlocks the angle: $\theta = \frac{s}{r}$. Then sector area is $\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta$.

Radians make both formulas clean. The $\frac{1}{2}$ is the whole question.
